reviewNote: Project adoption of 282 explicit cells in the central thin septal membrane between the frontal horns, app Y275-300. The original registered300 images, 31 adjacent coronal planes, 4 sagittal and 29 axial planes show a thin median wall below corpus callosum, above the broad inferior septal attachment. Root reviewed 18 native100 planes with final candidate outlines at app references [196,275,171] and [196,290,162]. A further actual native100 center+8-corner measurement excludes cells containing bright fluid/partial volume. Intensity and connectivity did not determine structure identity. The sampled support is partial membrane tissue, not all septal nuclei, fascicles, fornix or the complete septum pellucidum. Current labels at all 282 cells are 0 before application; cerebellar repair is spatially separate.
limitation: Only surviving internal portions of the membrane on the 0.5 mm grid. Eight disconnected components (181,71,12,7,5,3,2,1) retained without joining or smoothing; gaps are not a complete map of anatomical fenestrations. Y301-305 callosal attachment candidates remain deferred. No expert validation or quiz eligibility.

before.scope: section-view BigBrain selection/context only; not expert validation
